description: This file defines the VertexBase class for handling authentication, URL generation, and credential management for Google Vertex AI and Google AI Studio models. It includes methods for loading credentials, refreshing tokens, constructing API URLs, and managing access tokens, with specific support for different credential types and external providers.

classes.name: VertexBase
classes.description: A class for managing authentication, URL construction, and credential handling for Google Vertex AI and Google AI Studio models.

methods.name: get_vertex_region
methods.description: Returns the appropriate region for Vertex AI, defaulting to 'global' or 'us-central1'.

methods.name: load_auth
methods.description: Loads credentials from a string or dict, handling different credential types and scopes.

methods.name: refresh_auth
methods.description: Refreshes the credentials using Google's Request object.

methods.name: _ensure_access_token
methods.description: Returns an access token and project ID, handling different providers like 'gemini'.

methods.name: is_using_v1beta1_features
methods.description: Determines if beta features should be used based on optional parameters.

methods.name: _check_custom_proxy
methods.description: Constructs the appropriate API URL and headers for Gemini or Vertex AI, supporting PSC endpoints.

methods.name: _get_token_and_url
methods.description: Internal method to retrieve the token and URL for API calls, handling Gemini and Vertex AI URLs.

methods.name: _handle_reauthentication
methods.description: Handles reauthentication when token refresh fails, retrying once.

methods.name: get_access_token
methods.description: Retrieves a valid access token and project ID, refreshing credentials if expired.

methods.name: set_headers
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with authorization and extra headers.

methods.name: get_vertex_ai_project
methods.description: Extracts the Vertex AI project ID from parameters or secrets.

methods.name: get_vertex_ai_credentials
methods.description: Extracts the Vertex AI credentials from parameters or secrets.

methods.name: get_vertex_ai_location
methods.description: Extracts the Vertex AI location/region from parameters or secrets.

methods.name: safe_get_vertex_ai_project
methods.description: Safely retrieves the project ID without mutating the parameters.

methods.name: safe_get_vertex_ai_credentials
methods.description: Safely retrieves the credentials without mutating the parameters.

methods.name: safe_get_vertex_ai_location
methods.description: Safely retrieves the location/region without mutating the parameters.
